seo.title: About ODD — why we exist and what we do
seo.description: ODD exists to connect Finland's creative and cultural fields with business and wider society through events, spaces and projects.

panels.alt: Two people talking at a creative exhibition
panels.title: This is ODD.
panels.body: ODD exists to bring Finland's creative and cultural fields closer to business and wider society — while building better conditions for creative work itself. We do it through events, spaces and projects where people can meet, make, learn and build together.

panels.alt: Motion-blurred crowd at an ODD event
panels.title: Finland doesn't lack creativity. Too much of it still happens in separate rooms.
panels.body: Creative work is often built project by project, grant by grant and production by production. The work can be brilliant while the spaces, relationships and continuity around it remain fragile. At the same time, business and institutions too rarely spend real time with the people shaping culture. ODD works on both problems at once: more room for creative work to grow, and more contact between the worlds around it.

panels.title: Different ways to make the same idea real.

Creatives, communities, businesses,
institutions, partners, audiences.
panels.body: People arrive at ODD from different places, but they do not need to stay in separate boxes. An artist can come to ODDference. A company can host something at ODDfest. An ODDspace member can build a project with an organisation they met through ODD. The point is not to protect the boundaries between these worlds. It is to make crossing them normal.

milestones.title: New Nordic Way rf founded
milestones.body: New Nordic Way rf is founded in Helsinki, creating the organisational home for what would later become ODD.

milestones.title: Finding the gap
milestones.body: The idea starts taking shape around a gap that keeps showing up: strong creative work, but too few lasting places and relationships connecting it across fields and with the rest of society.

milestones.title: ODDfest pilots
milestones.body: The first ODDfest launches in Helsinki — around 2,600 participants, 350+ contributors and 70+ partners, reaching over a million people in total.

milestones.title: Creative Week, ODDference and ODDspace
milestones.body: Creative Week tests a distributed, city-wide model; ODDference launches as its own professional event; and the first ODDspace opens in Vallila, giving the work a year-round home.

milestones.title: ODDfest opens up further
milestones.body: The Creative Week model becomes ODDfest: an open, city-wide week made by independent organisers across Helsinki, alongside year-round ODDspace and ODDference.

people.title: The people and organisation behind ODD.
people.orgDescription: ODD is operated by New Nordic Way rf, a Finnish non-profit based in Helsinki. ODD is the public name for the events, spaces and projects we build; New Nordic Way rf is the organisation behind them.

network.title: Built with.
network.note: Built together with the partners, venues and institutions below — with more joining as ODD grows.

ambition.headline: A more creative Finland.
ambition.body: A more creative Finland is better for the people making culture, better for the organisations trying to build what comes next, and simply a more interesting place to live. ODD cannot build that alone. Our part is practical: create more places for creative work to happen, more ways for it to be seen and supported, and more contact between the people making culture and the rest of society.
